```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

## Spreadsheet structure

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
average_births <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(average_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(average_births, aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = average_births)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.name,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean births") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    births_december_25 = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_average = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * births_december_25 / surrounding_average,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
christmas_births
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday on December 25"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = 100 * residuals(births_model) / mean(births))

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))) |>
  select(calendar_date, mean_pct_resid) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- tribble(
  ~calendar_date, ~holiday, ~label_date, ~label_y,
  as.Date("2001-12-24"), "Christmas Eve", as.Date("2001-12-12"), -32,
  as.Date("2001-12-25"), "Christmas Day", as.Date("2001-12-28"), -46,
  as.Date("2001-01-01"), "New Year's Day", as.Date("2001-01-10"), -24
) |>
  left_join(calendar_resid, by = "calendar_date")

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_segment(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid, xend = label_date, yend = label_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean residual (% of overall mean births)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
